dr006BackupLayers.mechanism: Supabase cloud continuous WAL archiving & storage snapshots
dr006BackupLayers.whatItProtects: Physical host/disk failures, catastrophic cloud data center disasters
dr006BackupLayers.whatItCannotRecover: Logical application errors immediately before manual intervention without rewind
dr006BackupLayers.retention: 7 to 30 days (depending on Supabase project tier)
dr006BackupLayers.actualAvailability: Active on Cloud Supabase (AWS ap-south-1 Mumbai)

dr006BackupLayers.mechanism: Physical WAL replay to discrete second timestamp
dr006BackupLayers.whatItProtects: Accidental drop table, rogue batch update, database corruption
dr006BackupLayers.whatItCannotRecover: Uncommitted transactions or mutations outside WAL window
dr006BackupLayers.actualAvailability: Platform supported; classified as NOT EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED

dr006BackupLayers.mechanism: Generated entity JSON/SQL dumps and deterministic combined bundles
dr006BackupLayers.whatItProtects: Total cloud project deletion, cross-cloud platform migration, disaster bootstrapping
dr006BackupLayers.whatItCannotRecover: Live end-user session state generated after export timestamp
dr006BackupLayers.retention: Permanent in version-controlled Git history / disk backup artifacts
dr006BackupLayers.actualAvailability: Committed in-repo & verified via live export drill

dr006BackupLayers.mechanism: 36 individual sequential SQL migration files in supabase/migrations/
dr006BackupLayers.whatItProtects: Schema definition integrity, incremental evolution, zero-drift rollback
dr006BackupLayers.whatItCannotRecover: Dynamic user-generated runtime data (NEVER a backup of user data)

dr006BackupLayers.mechanism: Demographic, geographic, and electoral seed scripts in data/seed/ and scripts/
dr006BackupLayers.whatItProtects: Ground-truth political geography, delimitation boundaries, state assemblies
dr006BackupLayers.whatItCannotRecover: Dynamic user profiles or transactional activity

dr001.name: Cold Database Reconstruction & Live API Bootstrap
dr001.testDataset: 36 Sequential Migrations + All Combined Bundle (360KB) + State Reference Seeds
dr001.limitations: Disaster recovery drill verified schema compilation, staging catalog synchronization, and live DB-backed API retrieval in ~7s; this is NOT a full cold cloud database reconstruction RTO because fresh cloud project provisioning from zero remains outside the automated drill (target ≤ 15 min requires cloud provider project creation).

dr002.name: Real Selective Data Recovery & Logical Backup Restore
dr002.testDataset: 3 Synthetic civic_issues Records (Full Entities with UUIDs, Enums, Timestamps)
dr002.limitations: Data recovery proven via generated disk backup artifact extraction and live staging replay; physical continuous WAL point-in-time rewind requires cloud console access and is classified as NOT EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED.

dr003.name: API Failover & Standby Instance Recovery
dr003.multiCloudStatus: MULTI_CLOUD_STANDBY = NOT IMPLEMENTED / HUMAN INFRASTRUCTURE REQUIRED
dr003.environment: Local Standby Fastify Engine / Staging Gateway
dr003.limitations: Automated multi-cloud failover to secondary cloud host (Fly.io / Render) is NOT IMPLEMENTED / HUMAN INFRASTRUCTURE REQUIRED; local process standby recovery is tested in 4.5s.

dr004.name: Real Staging Storage Object Recovery
dr004.testDataset: Synthetic 1x1 PNG Media Object (70 bytes binary)
dr004.limitations: Storage recovery proven on live Supabase storage bucket via artifact restore; automated multi-region cross-cloud bucket replication is managed at provider tier.

dr005.name: Client Offline Resilience & Mutation Queueing
dr005.testDataset: 4 Favorite Constituency IDs + Offline Mutation Queue
dr005.limitations: Client offline resilience operates synchronously in 0s using MMKV adapter tier; not classified as traditional cloud disaster-recovery RTO.
